latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Generator Video — Create Videos from Text Prompts.

- Instantly generate 30-second promotional videos from text prompts or uploaded media, with background music.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG files up to 500MB; handles video generation via cloud AI backend.
- Streamlined setup with automatic API connection, free 7-day anonymous token, and session management.
- Exports videos in 1080p MP4 format, processed and delivered in 1–2 minutes.
- Integrated commands for upload, download, credits, and session state with robust error handling.
- Designed for non-experts: perfect for marketers and creators wanting fast, automated video production.
